name: Zengővárkony (Hungary)
description: Two horizontal stripes of green over yellow in the ratio 2:1, charged in the upper hoist with a white disc bearing the municipal arms of Zengővárkony with a helm and red and green mantling.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Zengővárkony arms with helm and mantling
